@June Osei-Lark: on 1 Jul at 09:17 Gideon said he closed out **ticket #8841** with support. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a **browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets**, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team.

One thing to check: a strategic digest dated 30 Sep also uses #8841 for a different issue, a Dock Door 14 kiosk problem at Newark. The ticket number may have been reused, or one of the records may be wrong. I can't confirm which from here, so it's worth checking the support ticket itself.
